annotations.note: Shipped whole and unfiltered. The selection rule is part of the task, so filtering the set here would answer the first rung in the input.

reference_records.attribution: MIBiG antiSMASH-processed reference set (https://dl.secondarymetabolites.org/mibig/mibig_antismash_4.0_gbk_as8b1.tar.bz2), licensed CC BY 4.0
reference_records.note: The records are the processed GenBank files as published, including their CDS translations, which is what the audit reads. They are NOT re-run through the image's antiSMASH: this campaign never compares output from two antiSMASH versions, which antiSMASH's own rules forbid.
reference_records.selection_rule: every MIBiG entry of biosynthetic class 'ribosomal' for which the source set carries a record, unchanged
